sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects. Both leverage large-scale speech training data and the strong audio understanding capability of their foundation model, Qwen3-Omni.

sources.title: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is a multilingual automatic speech recognition model (~2B parameters, ~1.7B active, BF16) from Alibaba's Qwen3-ASR family that transcribes speech while identifying the spoken language across 30 languages, 22 Chinese dialects, and a range of regional English accents — and it holds up on hard audio including singing voice and ...
